run_ldm3d_pipeline: run the GaudiStableDiffusionLDM3DPipeline to generate RGB images and depth maps from text prompts on HPU
prepare_latents: create initial noise latents for Stable Diffusion LDM3D image generation with configurable shape and dtype
capture_replay_hpu_graph: capture and replay HPU graphs for cached UNet forward passes to accelerate inference on Gaudi
unet_hpu_forward: run the UNet forward pass on HPU with optional HPU graph capture and replay for denoising latents
review_ldm3d_output: review the GaudiStableDiffusionLDM3DPipelineOutput dataclass that holds RGB images, depth maps, throughput, and NSFW detection
